kinds.d: Rod or cane pushed into the soil to hold up a plant.
Tie, twine, clip or tape that fastens a plant to its support.
Wire or plastic cage, ring or grow-through grid that holds up a whole plant or clump.
Open lattice panel on which climbing plants are trained.
Arched frame over a path on which climbing plants are grown.
Free-standing tapering frame on which climbing plants are grown.
Tag or marker that names a plant in a pot or bed.

notes: Restraint only. Plant tying tool (tapener) merged into Plant tie as a type, its alias carried over. No old models existed. No new kinds, brands or archetypes.
